# InlineEdit

InlineEdit — text that reads as text and becomes a field when it is pressed. The read view and the edit view are drawn at the same size, so opening the editor does not move anything around it. Enter or leaving the editor confirms; Escape cancels. Confirm and cancel buttons sit under the edit view and can be left off. `validate` can refuse a value with a message, and the editor stays open. The parent holds the value. `defaultValue` is what the edit view starts with each time it opens, and `onConfirm` is where the new value goes. Not for use inside a form: it saves on its own and has no say in the form's submit. Use `Input` there.

**Import:** `import { InlineEdit } from '@/components';`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | Base id for the edit view's control; the label points at it while editing. |
| `label` | node | — | Shown above both views. |
| `defaultValue` | any | — | What the edit view starts with each time it opens. The parent updates it after a confirm. |
| `readView` | func (required) | — | Returns the read view's content. Keep it to plain text: the whole view is one button. |
| `editView` | func (required) | — | Returns the edit view, given `{ id, value, onChange, validation, validationMessage, isSaving }`. `onChange` takes a value or a change event. |
| `onConfirm` | func | — | Called with the value on Enter, on leaving the editor and on the confirm button. Throw or reject to keep the editor open with the error. |
| `onCancel` | func | — | Called when Escape or the cancel button closes the editor. |
| `onEdit` | func | — | Called when the editor opens. |
| `validate` | func | — | Returns a message to refuse the value, or nothing to accept it. May be async. |
| `keepEditViewOpenOnBlur` | bool | `false` | Leaving the editor no longer confirms; only Enter and the confirm button do. |
| `startWithEditViewOpen` | bool | `false` | Opens in the edit view and puts the caret in it. |
| `hideActionButtons` | bool | `false` | Leaves off the confirm and cancel buttons. Enter, Escape and leaving the editor still work. |
| `compact` | bool | `false` | The 24 height, with the compact buttons. |
| `readViewFitContainerWidth` | bool | `false` | The read view fills its container, so the whole row is one press target. |
| `editLabel` | string | `'Edit'` | What a screen reader hears after the read view, naming what pressing does. |
| `confirmLabel` | string | `'Confirm'` | — |
| `cancelLabel` | string | `'Cancel'` | — |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
